apps.name: Ratchet
apps.tagline: An accountability timer that only turns one way.
apps.summary: Ratchet lives in the menu bar and asks, every minute, what you are doing and which goal it serves. Untracked time counts against you, work with no goal is impossible to start, and each sitting ends with a yes or no: did you do what you said? Goals nest into trees with deadlines and finish bonuses, and a 1000-point day score makes drift visible the moment it starts. One Cloudflare Durable Object holds the state, so the Mac app, the phone PWA and a public dashboard all stay in step.
apps.stack: Python · PyObjC · TypeScript · Cloudflare Durable Objects

apps.name: Torque
apps.tagline: A small, opinionated dog who reads your Ratchet data and pushes.
apps.summary: Torque is Ratchet's coach: a Claude Code skill that pulls goals, pace and history from the cloud and writes short, data-grounded briefs (morning plan, mid-session push, evening review, weekly review) with one-tap proposals straight back into the app. It pushes two ways without being asked: faster on the goals you have, and bigger goals than you would set yourself. It runs on a Claude subscription through Claude Code, with no API key.
apps.stack: Claude Code skill · Ratchet cloud API

apps.name: Sieve
apps.tagline: Read X and LinkedIn without ever seeing a raw post.
apps.summary: Sieve hides every post on X and LinkedIn before it paints and shows what your lens makes of it instead: keep, skim or drop, a category colour, signal pips, and a de-hyped rewrite in a voice you choose. 'Brief me' turns a whole session into one digest. Model calls go through a native-messaging host to a locked-down claude -p with no tools, because posts are untrusted input.
apps.stack: Firefox extension · native messaging · Claude Code

apps.name: DeBait
apps.tagline: YouTube titles rewritten to say what the video actually contains.
apps.summary: DeBait reads each video's transcript (or description) and replaces the clickbait title with one plain sentence about what's in it, using a local or OpenAI-compatible model. Hover to see the original; Alt+Shift+O flips every title back.
apps.stack: Firefox extension · local LLM (Ollama / LM Studio)

apps.name: Treasury
apps.tagline: Every account, card and brokerage in one encrypted local dashboard.
apps.summary: Treasury pulls banks, credit cards and brokerages (Robinhood included) through Plaid and shows spending, cash flow, net worth and holdings in one place, so money stops being a background worry. It runs only on the Mac: one AES-256-GCM vault keyed by scrypt, loopback-only with a DNS-rebinding guard, auto-lock, strict CSP, and zero npm dependencies.

apps.name: OTP Clipboard
apps.tagline: One-time codes land on your clipboard; reset links never auto-open.
apps.summary: A daemon that watches agent inboxes over a websocket. Sign-in codes go straight to the clipboard so you never leave what you're doing. Account links (password resets, magic sign-ins) wait in a menu-bar list showing their real destination host, because a reset link is as good as a password. Extraction is regex only, tested against twelve providers and six false-positive traps.

apps.name: Parenting Probe
apps.tagline: Test a parenting strategy on simulated children before trying it on real ones.
apps.summary: Several small open models (Llama, Mistral, Gemma) play children with distinct personas; a fixed Qwen judge scores whether each one complies, and whether they still eat the broccoli once the parent leaves the room. A held-out set of unseen children, including a distribution-shifted split, checks whether a conclusion generalises.
